report.summary: The stepped low-shed silhouette, muted metal palette, flat roofs, and yellow south garage bay are recognizable and stylistically coherent. The east personnel entrance—the strongest principal-entry evidence—is not legible enough in the model, so it is not ready.

orientation.summary: The located SV3 looks west almost head-on at the east-facing -v facade and shows a full-height rust-brown personnel door beside a pale window. The inventory places the sole personnel door on -v, while +u correctly carries only three garage/service doors corresponding to the southwest SV1/SV2 side. No duplicate personnel portal is inventoried; placement is therefore correct, though its rendering is defective.

issues.problem: On the -v face render, the principal rust-brown personnel door reads as another small pale window and does not visibly extend to grade, contradicting SV3.
issues.fix: Make the -v portal clearly full-height and ground-reaching, restore its rust-brown color, and retain the adjacent pale window.

issues.problem: The +u labeled face view is largely blocked by an extreme roof close-up, preventing useful facade inspection.
issues.fix: Move the +u camera outward and downward so all three south-facing garage bays are visible.

issues.problem: The exterior appears unusually clean and horizontally banded compared with the reference shed’s weathered corrugated-metal character.
issues.fix: Use subtler corrugated metal ribs and restrained gray/rust weathering while preserving the simplified miniature style.
